alt: New 2026 Coca-Cola global brand refresh showing the redesigned red-and-white cans and bottles with the updated tall serif typeface that internet users compare to Marlboro cigarette packaging
story: On July 20, 2026 Coca-Cola launched a global visual identity refresh — its new 'Better With' serif typeface is so similar to Marlboro's font that social media users immediately posted side-by-side comparisons, calling it the 'fridge cigarette' rebrand; simultaneously, swapping from black to white lettering makes Coke Zero nearly indistinguishable from regular Coke, alarming diabetics who rely on the colour difference.
why_funny: The world's most iconic drink brand paid a branding agency millions to look 'more Coca-Cola' and accidentally arrived at 'more Marlboro' — while also making the safe-for-diabetics version of their drink invisible on the shelf.
